title: BetweenInterpretation
description: The structured output contract Between models must produce for one target message.

literalMeaning.description: What the words say on their face.

possibleImpliedMeanings.description: Alternative readings beyond the literal one; may include the literal reading as a possibility when relevant.

possibleEmotions.description: Hedged emotion possibilities ('possibly frustrated'), never asserted as fact.

speechAct.description: What the message does in the conversation (e.g., soft refusal, indirect request).

literalness.description: How likely the message is meant beyond its literal words.

confidence.description: Strength of contextual support for the leading nonliteral reading. High values should be rare.

evidence.description: Contextual cues actually used, phrased as observations.

missingContext.description: Information that would change the reading; empty array when context is sufficient.

suggestedAction.description: A reversible, low-pressure next step for the reader.

suggestedMessage.description: Optional example phrasing for a clarifying message, or null.
